subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about acquiring funded loans in your licensed states. The math here is unforgiving: 67 to 68 percent of online loan applications are abandoned, and online lenders commonly report $400 to $500 per acquired borrower, so the tier you share with LendingClub and OneMain Financial pays dearly for each borrower who funds. That is why incrementality decides your real cost. We hold paid funded loans against a holdout, so they read as incremental to the finance-intent borrowers you would have won organically. Worth comparing against your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: top-funnel abandonment + $400-$500 CAC band frames incrementality
